adjacent_boundaries.category_boundary: SPK-03 speaker change detection and segmentation
adjacent_boundaries.relation: A change point or locally homogeneous segment does not link a speaker's later turns into a session-wide anonymous label map.
Frame or local speaker segmentation is only one stage; without pinned embeddings, clustering and a label-linking policy it is not a diarization result.
An embedding or similarity score is not a timestamped speaker-label map and does not establish anonymous session clusters.
The historical Hush rows use AMI speaker IDs only to construct speaker-dominant mixtures; the output is one enhanced waveform, not labels.
Enrollment-conditioned extraction selects a known target; anonymous diarization clusters unenrolled speakers within a session.

controls.name: DER/JER and speaker-error metric with collar and UEM
controls.role: Required diarization metric family; no implementation, collar policy, UEM mask or scored value exists in this task.

controls.name: always-one-speaker and oracle-speaker-count degenerate controls
controls.role: Required degenerate baselines that expose clustering and count failure; neither was run on a valid diarization cohort.

controls.name: speaker-level truth versus any-speaker union
controls.role: Both representations must be preserved; a union-only score cannot establish anonymous speaker labels or cluster identity.

controls.name: unknown-region masking
controls.role: Unannotated time is excluded, never relabelled nonspeech, non-speech or a new speaker.

controls.name: overlap-aware versus exclusive-label scoring
controls.role: Speaker-level overlap truth and an any-speaker union must remain separate; exclusive-label scoring silently discards simultaneous speech.

controls.name: anonymous-label permutation and online revision
controls.role: Anonymous cluster names are arbitrary and may be revised online; no label-permutation assignment or revision policy exists locally.

controls.name: identity / passthrough audio
controls.role: Diarization is annotation and never modifies PCM; an identity control guards against a gate or separator being credited as a diarizer.

controls.name: synthetic speaker-pair mixture versus natural meeting
controls.role: Constructed additive turns test robustness but do not substitute for naturally simultaneous speech, natural turn-taking or speaker-label truth.

controls.name: anonymous session cluster versus enrolled identity
controls.role: A session label is not a person, gallery match or verification decision; identity and diarization require separate outputs and metrics.

controls.name: missing, invalid, nonfinite and out-of-range interval rejection
controls.role: Missing or malformed labels are blocked, not scored; no missing result may qualify a candidate or produce a diarization claim.
